name: TalentAxis Java Foundation Test
description: Evaluates basic Java syntax, OOP concepts, core libraries, and fundamental programming algorithms for entry-level developers.

name: TalentAxis Web Development Core
description: Assesses front-end development fundamentals, responsive layout construction, DOM manipulation, and basic asynchronous Javascript logic.

name: TalentAxis Coding Aptitude & Logic
description: Measures basic analytical reasoning, pattern recognition, and logical problem-solving abilities crucial for programming roles.

name: Engineering Collaboration Simulator
description: Presents realistic workplace scenarios involving agile standups, code review feedback, and peer collaboration to assess teamwork and communication.

name: TalentAxis Advanced System Design
description: Evaluates system architecture design, scalability concepts, microservices structure, database selection, caching strategies, and performance optimization for senior technical roles.

name: TalentAxis Python Masterclass Test
description: Measures advanced programming competencies, concurrency patterns, memory management, and package engineering expertise in Python.

name: Technical Leadership & Architecture Judgment
description: Evaluates decision-making capabilities regarding technology adoption, legacy migration tradeoffs, code quality governance, and mentorship of junior engineers.

name: Cognitive Complexity & Analysis
description: Measures advanced cognitive capacity, complex data pattern analysis, and strategic technical troubleshooting under tight constraints.

name: TalentAxis Sales Drive & Motivation
description: Measures core personality traits crucial for sales success, including achievement orientation, resilience under rejection, extraversion, and competitive drive.

name: TalentAxis Negotiation & Influence Assessment
description: Situational judgement test assessing a candidate's ability to handle customer objections, pitch products effectively, and build immediate trust during sales conversations.

name: Active Listening & Verbal Comprehension
description: Measures verbal reasoning ability, active listening skills, and the capacity to extract and act on client requirements quickly.

name: B2B Sales Foundations & Strategy
description: Evaluates core knowledge of modern outbound sales techniques, lead qualifying frameworks, and professional email/call cadences.

name: Sales Team Leadership & Strategy
description: Assesses situational decision-making regarding sales quota allocation, pipeline bottlenecks, conflict resolution, and motivational coaching for sales professionals.

name: TalentAxis Sales Performance Analytics
description: Measures knowledge of sales metrics, CRMs, revenue forecasting, conversion rate math, and commercial pipeline reporting systems.

name: Strategic Sales Planning & Executive Presence
description: Measures high-level personality traits like emotional stability, assertiveness, long-term strategic vision, and client relationship management.

name: Commercial Decision Making
description: Measures numerical reasoning, market data trend analysis, and rapid risk-reward evaluation of large sales contracts.

name: TalentAxis Product Strategy & Discovery
description: Evaluates a product manager's ability to prioritize roadmap items, validate user needs, manage stakeholder expectations, and handle launch trade-offs through situational scenarios.

name: TalentAxis Agile Product Management (Scrum/Kanban)
description: Tests deep theoretical and practical understanding of Agile methodologies, user story creation, backlog refinement, and release planning.

name: Analytical & Critical Reasoning for Product
description: Measures data-driven problem solving, hypothesis validation, and metric-based analysis (e.g., churn, acquisition funnel, LTV) necessary for product performance.

name: Product Manager Leadership & Alignment
description: Assesses personality indicators relating to cross-functional influence without authority, empathy, communication clarity, and adaptability to market shifts.

name: TalentAxis AppSec & Threat Modeling
description: Tests understanding of secure software development lifecycles, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, cryptography principles, and practical threat modeling techniques.

name: TalentAxis Network Security & Pentesting
description: Evaluates technical skills in network protocol security, intrusion detection systems, penetration testing tools, and firewall management.

name: Incident Response & Crisis Management
description: Situational judgement test assessing a candidate's response protocols during a live security breach, system compromise, or data leak event.

name: Logical Security Reasoning & Analysis
description: Measures analytical ability, systematic debugging, pattern recognition in firewall/system logs, and rapid deduction of intrusion vectors.

name: TalentAxis Employee Relations & Policy
description: Evaluates situational judgment regarding workplace disputes, policy enforcement, labor law compliance, performance improvement plans, and termination procedures.

name: TalentAxis Strategic HR & Talent Acquisition
description: Tests theoretical knowledge of workforce planning, competitive compensation structures, behavioral interviewing techniques, and employee onboarding design.

name: HR Leader Empathy & Influence
description: Measures personality traits indicating high emotional intelligence, interpersonal sensitivity, confidentiality handling, and structural diplomacy.

name: Conflict Resolution Simulator
description: Situational judgement test featuring realistic videos or textual conflict scenes between cross-functional partners and evaluating the proposed HR mediator actions.

name: TalentAxis SQL & Data Querying
description: Measures technical mastery of writing optimized SQL queries, joins, aggregates, subqueries, analytical window functions, and database schema knowledge.

name: TalentAxis Data Visualization & BI Tools
description: Tests understanding of data visualization best practices, dashboard design principles, key metrics modeling, and automated report building in tools like PowerBI/Tableau.

name: TalentAxis Quantitative Reasoning & Statistics
description: Measures mathematical and statistical aptitude, probability calculations, trend hypothesis testing, and quantitative problem-solving.

name: Analytical Mindset & Inquiry
description: Assesses personality traits related to detail-orientation, patience in debugging datasets, intellectual curiosity, and rigorous hypothesis verification.

name: TalentAxis Support Empathy & Patience
description: Measures personality profiles showing strong customer-centric behavior, emotional regulation, patience with difficult users, and active empathy.

name: Customer Complaint & De-escalation Simulator
description: Assesses situational handling of angry customers, refund disputes, service ticket backlogs, and SLA compliance choices.

name: TalentAxis Ticket Systems & Troubleshooting
description: Tests standard support desk tool navigation, basic IT system architecture troubleshooting, knowledge base lookup speed, and ticket logging clarity.

name: Verbal Communication & Comprehension
description: Measures prompt reading comprehension, written email syntax skills, and grammatical accuracy for digital customer support.

name: TalentAxis Modern Team Leadership
description: Evaluates decision making around team productivity optimization, delegation of responsibilities, performance management, coaching, and career development support.

name: TalentAxis Emotional Intelligence & Leadership Style
description: Assesses leadership personality traits, self-awareness, social capabilities, stress tolerance, and strategic alignment behavior.

name: Strategic Project Management & Agile Delivery
description: Tests foundational knowledge of milestone planning, agile sprint estimation, resource capacity calculations, and delivery risk management.

name: Complex Problem Deconstruction
description: Measures abstract logical reasoning, structural problem analysis, and root cause analysis in operational scenarios.
